message: You know, I always thought I was a little too prepared for storms, but I finally see the upside. I stumbled upon some great tips about tornado readiness that made me feel like the wise owl in a room full of chickens. It's nice to be the one who knows where to go when the sky gets a bit grumpy. Remember, it’s not about fearing the storm, but being ready for whatever it brings. 🌪️
